notes.en:
• Check for new versions online, read release notes and open the matching download page for manual installation.
• Enlarge and optically center the monochrome app icon while preserving its white margin.
• Center the home greeting and choose fresh copy, logo motion and text entrance for each new session.
• Add two smooth logo animations and three text entrances, with system reduced-motion support.
notes.zh-CN:
• 联网检查新版本，展示更新内容，点击进入对应下载页后手动安装。
• 放大并调整黑白应用图标的视觉中心，保留白底留白。
• 首页文字与 Logo 居中对齐，每次新会话随机搭配文案、Logo 动画和文字效果。
• 新增两种流畅 Logo 动画和三种文字入场效果，支持系统减少动态效果设置。
